reviewer: Independent read-only UI/draft source child of section_contract_audit
sourceScope: Frozen current working-tree section implementation, fingerprinted below; not a committed-source/runtime/native-quality acceptance claim.

checks.finding: intent remains verbatim. Target/targetDraft is separate. New current edits start with blank section/format; notes require a displayed exact paragraph and matching hash/base revision. Selection onChange writes only browser state; no API/auto-start. The exact ambiguous Make this clearer for a newcomer phrase takes clarification path before child creation/inference.

Unknown/stale paragraph identities stay in targetDraft and visible detail; no automatic retarget. Unavailable current-base eligibility disables Save/retry without deleting the draft. Original input/partial choices survive local storage and close/reopen; unreadable raw drafts are preserved and require explicit backup before replacement.

checks.area: Uncertain submission versus newer unsent choices
checks.finding: The submitted snapshot includes intent, target section, paragraph index/hash, format and request key. Newer partial/current choices are compared before clearing and retained under a new unsent key. GET inspection only reconciles a child matching saved parent/request identity; same key with a different target or format rejects server-side. Retry uses the original submitted snapshot deliberately, not newer form choices.

checks.area: No notes substitution when summary selected
checks.finding: UI uses notesEdit only for explicit notes target and renders factual summary otherwise; no paragraph selector silently changes target. Backend notes projection keeps summary exact, and summary state rejects unexpected notesEdit/review metadata. Explicit original-intent preservation/opposite-section literal conflicts trigger clarification. Target summary format is a user choice; original request is retained separately.

checks.area: Rendered and raw rejected proposal inspection
checks.finding: Note text is React-escaped plain text. Before/proposed rendering and exact selected-range removed/added JSON are inspectable; no host rewritten prose or model markup execution. Raw writer/reviewer errors remain available even when the proposal is rejected or malformed. Source and unchanged-summary evidence are explicit rather than substituted for the selected note.

evidence: ResearchBriefEdit.tsx:109–160 approval identity and meaning flags
checks.finding: UI Apply binds operationId plus proposalSha256, requires accepted awaiting-approval phase, needs_input, no conflict and every note-meaning/planned/clarity flag. StateFrom requires accepted host and support checks for awaiting/approved/rendered/saved; approve and execute recheck current literal guards. A reviewer flag cannot waive failed host guards. Server hash includes selected target, unchanged summary and proposed full notes.

evidence: ResearchBriefEdit.tsx:204–240 native dialog and fixed actions
checks.finding: Native modal open is explicit; initial heading focus and close trigger focus are requested. Escape/Cancel only closes review; it submits neither Apply nor Stop. Fixed opaque footer and bounded middle scroller remain the existing layout; narrow CSS stacks comparison. Parent links name personal-note target and base version; Continue explicitly does not approve/reapply. Actual keyboard/touch/layout behavior is pending owner browser evidence.

limitations: Static source inspection only: no tests, browser calls, model calls, service changes, source edits or data writes were performed by this review.
All ten isolated native diagnostics remain failed; these source guards/UI controls do not establish successful native note rewriting, semantic preservation or useful exported output.

documentEditTargetMismatch and legacy intent detection are declared narrow literal heuristics, not general intent/negation classifiers. Unrecognized wording cannot be advertised as a complete mismatch detector.

Original-v0 legacy summary/explicit-label requests remain a compatibility path; new current-version edits and the exact ambiguous phrase use explicit section/format clarification. This is not evidence every legacy free-text format is newly clarified.
Raw JSON comparison is an exact replacement/range diff, not an independent semantic explanation. Native meaning-review flags remain fallible.
Server-side approval/state guards were read to validate UI assumptions; full backend recovery/history audit belongs to the parent reviewer.
